30/S0.subgoal: Explain the social, warning, and primitive levels of sound perception and how they guide the choice of auditory effects in XR.

30/S1.subgoal: Describe psychophysical and psychoacoustic laws that explain loudness perception and how they inform sound design.

30/S2.subgoal: Explain pitch perception and how the just noticeable difference for frequency varies with frequency.

30/S3.subgoal: Explain why sound localization is important in XR and describe the minimum audible angle and spherical-coordinate parameters used to represent sound source location.

30/S4.subgoal: Explain how binaural localization cues and head-related transfer functions are used to render localized binaural sound in XR.

30/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
